name: 天象日历
description: 流星雨观测夜、日月食与行星冲日／大距，来自 IMO、日本国立天文台及香港天文台。观测条件随地区而异。
description_en: Meteor shower observing nights, eclipses, planetary oppositions and elongations from IMO, NAOJ and HKO. Visibility depends on location.
attribution: International Meteor Organization; National Astronomical Observatory of Japan; Hong Kong Observatory

events.name: 木星冲日
events.description: 日本国立天文台公布的行星天象；原表时区为 UTC+8。观测条件随所在地而异。
events.description_en: Planetary phenomenon published by NAOJ in UTC+8. Observability depends on location.

events.name: 日环食
events.description: 香港天文台年历列出的全球日月食日期。并非所有事件都能在香港或中国大陆看到；可见地区及接触时刻请查看原公告。
events.description_en: Global eclipse date listed in the Hong Kong Observatory almanac. Visibility is regional; consult the original bulletin for visible areas and local contact times.
